summary: Constructor/initializer for an AI constraint solver parameter block: first tears down prior vtable state via VtableMethodShutdown, then writes a fixed set of 16 fields including control bytes, float limits (90.0, 75.0, 2.0, 3.25), an invalid handle (-1), and zeroed counters. Returns 0.

operations.description: Invoke VtableMethodShutdown to tear down prior vtable/interface state before reinitializing the block.
Initialize the control bytes: this+0x0 to 0, this+0x1 to 1 (active flag), this+0x2 to 0.
Set the float parameter fields: this+0x10 to 90.0f (literal 1119092736), this+0x14 to 75.0f (literal 1117126656), this+0x24 to 2.0f (literal 1073741824), this+0x30 to 3.25f (literal 1078984704).
Set the handle/index field this+0x18 to -1 (invalid).
Zero the remaining dword fields this+0x4, this+0x8, this+0xC, this+0x1C, this+0x20, this+0x28, this+0x2C, this+0x34.

unresolved: The field meanings are inferred from literal shape only; the float values 90.0/75.0/2.0/3.25 and the -1 handle are consistent with a constraint solver parameter block but unproven.
